subject: Follow-Up on Portfolio Review – Request for a Meeting
body:
Dear Mr. Al-Mansoori,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing further to the review recorded on 12 August 2026, in which a follow-up discussion was requested but has not yet taken place. I would like to ensure this matter receives the attention it deserves.

In particular, I note that Hong Kong industrials currently represent 24.3% of your overall wealth, spread across two positions and two instrument types. Given the significance of this concentration within your portfolio, I believe it would be valuable for us to meet and discuss this in detail.

Could we arrange a time in the coming days that suits your schedule? I am happy to meet at your convenience, whether in person or via video call.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
